questions.q: Which king of Persia let the Jews return to build the house of the LORD?
Who built the altar with Jeshua the priest?
What did the returned exiles set up first, before the foundation of the temple?
Why did the old men weep when the foundation was laid?
questions.a: They had seen the first house
acc: they had seen the first temple

questions.q: Whose offer to help build was refused?
questions.a: The adversaries of Judah and Benjamin

questions.q: Which two prophets stirred the people to build again?
Which king had the records searched and found Cyrus' decree?
What was Ezra?
questions.a: A ready scribe in the law of Moses

questions.q: What Ezra set his heart to — complete it.
questions.text: For Ezra had prepared his heart to [seek] the law of the LORD, and to [do] it, and to [teach] in Israel statutes and judgments.

questions.q: Why was Ezra ashamed to ask the king for soldiers?
questions.a: He had said God's hand is upon all them that seek him

questions.q: What did Ezra do when he heard the people had married foreign wives?
questions.a: He rent his garment and sat down astonied

questions.q: Which king sent Ezra to Jerusalem with a letter?
What did the people agree to do after Ezra's prayer?
questions.a: Make a covenant to put away the strange wives

questions.q: What did Ezra confess about God's punishment of Israel?
questions.a: God had punished them less than their iniquities deserved

questions.q: When the foundation was laid they sang that the LORD is good and his mercy endureth for ever.
How many were in the whole congregation of the first return?
acc: forty two thousand three hundred and sixty

questions.q: How did enemies stop the building in Artaxerxes' days?
questions.a: They wrote to the king accusing Jerusalem of rebellion

questions.q: What did Cyrus give back that Nebuchadnezzar had taken?
questions.a: The vessels of the house of the LORD

questions.q: Put these in the order Ezra tells them.
What did Ezra proclaim at the river Ahava to seek a right way?
